heroSummary: Boise School District K–12 students began Tuesday, August 12, 2025, on an early-release schedule. Pre-K and Early Childhood Special Education began August 18. Autumn Break was November 24–28, Winter Break was December 22–January 2, and Spring Break was March 16–20. Seniors, Pre-K, and ECSE finished May 14; K–11 students finished May 22, also on an early-release schedule.
calendarNotes: The firstDay field follows the broad K–12 calendar, while the lastDay field follows the K–11 calendar because seniors finished earlier; both dates used an early-release schedule. Pre-K and ECSE began August 18 and finished May 14. Seniors also finished May 14, while K–11 students continued through May 22. October 16 was a daytime no-class date for Pre-K through grade 6, not a districtwide closure; secondary conferences were held in the evening. October 17, November 4, and May 19 were districtwide no-school days. The regular calendar contained 176 instructional days. Two 18-day Secondary Summer School sessions continued after the regular last day.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Boise School District start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: K–12 starts Tuesday, August 12, 2025, with early release. Pre-K and ECSE programs start Monday, August 18.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Boise Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 22, 2025, through January 2, 2026. January 5 is a no-school professional-development day, and school resumes January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: Which Boise students had no school during fall conferences?
calendarFaqs.a: Pre-K through grade 6 had no classes October 16. Junior-high and high-school conferences were evening sessions. All Pre-K–12 students had no school October 17.

calendarFaqs.q: What time was early release in Boise schools in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Standard elementary schools dismissed at 1:15 p.m., and campuses on Boise’s late-start list dismissed at 1:45 p.m. Junior highs dismissed at noon when elementary schools also released early, while senior highs dismissed at 12:30 p.m.

calendarFaqs.q: When was the last day of school for Boise School District in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Seniors, Pre-K, and ECSE finished May 14. K–11 students finished Friday, May 22, on an early-release schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Boise Secondary Summer School in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Semester 1 runs June 3–27, with no class June 19. Semester 2 runs June 30–July 25, with no class July 4. Each session contains 18 days.
